description: Wraps the community StreamDiffusionTD.tox (by dotsimulate) into a one-shot Layer 1 setup: locate the .tox via candidate-path discovery, drop it into a fresh baseCOMP, wire a camera/source TOP into its input, set the prompt/strength/cfg/seed custom pars, and optionally re-broadcast the output via Syphon/Spout or NDI. Returns a friendly error when the .tox is not installed. The result envelope includes validated_pars so downstream tools (create_ai_mirror) know which SD pars to bind a control panel to.

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Low CFG (1–2) is normal for StreamDiffusion/LCM.

controlnet_weight.description: Sets Controlnetweight when the par is present in the tox build.

expose_controls.description: Reserved for v2 — the tox already surfaces its own UI; this field is accepted but not acted on in v1.

output_mode.description: internal = Null TOP only. syphon_spout / ndi = adds an FM-01 sender wired from out1.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the fresh streamdiffusion_driver baseCOMP.

prompt.default: a vibrant neon cyberpunk portrait, ultra detailed
prompt.description: Sets the Prompt custom par on the tox.

seed.description: Random seed. -1 = random per tox convention.

source_top_path.description: File system path to a video/image file to feed into the StreamDiffusionTD container (creates a moviefileinTOP). When omitted, a synthetic noise TOP is created for device-free preview.

strength.description: img2img denoising strength — sets Strength par.

t_index.description: Sets Tindex (denoise step list index) when present; omitted = tox default.

tox_path.description: Optional explicit absolute or project-relative override. When set, becomes the only candidate; standard discovery is skipped.

name: drive_streamdiffusion
title: Drive StreamDiffusionTD
